page.content:
New York's commercial theatre district: Times Square houses, Tonys, Equity, and the long-run hits.

How Broadway connects

  • Location: Broadway theatre district — The theatre district is the geographic body of Broadway.
  • Event: Tony Awards — The Tony Awards are Broadway's annual prizes.
  • Faction: The Shubert Organization — The Shubert Organization is Broadway's largest theatre landlord.
  • Work: Hamilton — Hamilton is the defining 2010s Broadway hit.
  • Work: The Phantom of the Opera — The Phantom of the Opera is Broadway's longest original-run monument.
  • Location: Times Square — Times Square is the lighted front door of Broadway.
  • Faction: Actors' Equity Association — Actors' Equity sets the Production Contract that governs Broadway companies.
  • Work: A Chorus Line — A Chorus Line is a defining 1970s Broadway musical.
  • Concept: the Great White Way — The Great White Way is the nickname for Broadway's lighted marquees.
  • Faction: The Nederlander Organization — The Nederlander Organization is a principal Broadway landlord.
  • Faction: The Broadway League — The Broadway League is the producers' and owners' trade group for Broadway.
  • Work: Wicked — Wicked is a long-running Broadway musical at the Gershwin.
  • Work: The Lion King — The Lion King is a permanent Times Square-scale Broadway spectacle.
  • Work: Oklahoma! — Oklahoma! reset the Broadway book musical in 1943.
  • Work: 42nd Street (musical) — 42nd Street is a backstage musical about Broadway itself.
  • Work: Chicago — Chicago's revival became one of Broadway's longest tenants.

What is Broadway?

Broadway is the Midtown theatre industry around Times Square and 42nd Street — Shubert, Nederlander, and Jujamcyn houses, Actors' Equity contracts, the Tony Awards, and a canon of musicals from A Chorus Line and The Phantom of the Opera to Hamilton.

Key threads lead to Broadway theatre district, Tony Awards, The Shubert Organization, Hamilton, The Phantom of the Opera and Times Square.

entity.name: Broadway
entity.short_description: New York's commercial theatre district: Times Square houses, Tonys, Equity, and the long-run hits.
entity.description: Broadway is the Midtown theatre industry around Times Square and 42nd Street — Shubert, Nederlander, and Jujamcyn houses, Actors' Equity contracts, the Tony Awards, and a canon of musicals from A Chorus Line and The Phantom of the Opera to Hamilton.

connections.title: The theatre district is the geographic body of Broadway.
connections.explanation: The theatre district is the geographic body of Broadway.
connections.name: Broadway theatre district
connections.short_description: Cluster of large commercial houses around Times Square in Midtown Manhattan.

connections.title: The Tony Awards are Broadway's annual prizes.
connections.explanation: The Tony Awards are Broadway's annual prizes.
connections.name: Tony Awards
connections.short_description: Annual prizes for Broadway plays and musicals, co-presented by the League and the Wing.

connections.title: The Shubert Organization is Broadway's largest theatre landlord.
connections.explanation: The Shubert Organization is Broadway's largest theatre landlord.
connections.name: The Shubert Organization
connections.short_description: Largest Broadway landlord, still named for the Shubert brothers.

connections.title: Hamilton is the defining 2010s Broadway hit.
connections.explanation: Hamilton is the defining 2010s Broadway hit.
connections.name: Hamilton
connections.short_description: Lin-Manuel Miranda musical that became Broadway's defining 2010s hit at the Richard Rodgers.

connections.title: The Phantom of the Opera is Broadway's longest original-run monument.
connections.explanation: The Phantom of the Opera is Broadway's longest original-run monument.
connections.name: The Phantom of the Opera
connections.short_description: Andrew Lloyd Webber musical that ran at the Majestic longer than any other Broadway show.

connections.title: Times Square is the lighted front door of Broadway.
connections.explanation: Times Square is the lighted front door of Broadway.
connections.name: Times Square
connections.short_description: Bowtie of Broadway and Seventh Avenue that fronts the theatre district.

connections.title: Actors' Equity sets the Production Contract that governs Broadway companies.
connections.explanation: Actors' Equity sets the Production Contract that governs Broadway companies.
connections.name: Actors' Equity Association
connections.short_description: Union that sets Broadway production contracts for actors and stage managers.

connections.title: A Chorus Line is a defining 1970s Broadway musical.
connections.explanation: A Chorus Line is a defining 1970s Broadway musical.
connections.name: A Chorus Line
connections.short_description: Michael Bennett workshop musical about the gypsies on the line, a long Shubert tenant.

connections.title: The Great White Way is the nickname for Broadway's lighted marquees.
connections.explanation: The Great White Way is the nickname for Broadway's lighted marquees.
connections.name: the Great White Way
connections.short_description: Nickname for the electrically lit stretch of Broadway through the theatre district.

connections.title: The Nederlander Organization is a principal Broadway landlord.
connections.explanation: The Nederlander Organization is a principal Broadway landlord.
connections.name: The Nederlander Organization
connections.short_description: Family-run Broadway and touring landlord opposite the Shuberts.

connections.title: The Broadway League is the producers' and owners' trade group for Broadway.
connections.explanation: The Broadway League is the producers' and owners' trade group for Broadway.
connections.name: The Broadway League
connections.short_description: Trade group of producers and presenters that co-presents the Tony Awards.

connections.title: Wicked is a long-running Broadway musical at the Gershwin.
connections.explanation: Wicked is a long-running Broadway musical at the Gershwin.
connections.name: Wicked
connections.short_description: Schwartz and Holzman Oz prequel that has held the Gershwin since 2003.

connections.title: The Lion King is a permanent Times Square-scale Broadway spectacle.
connections.explanation: The Lion King is a permanent Times Square-scale Broadway spectacle.
connections.name: The Lion King
connections.short_description: Julie Taymor Disney musical that turned puppet-mask staging into a Times Square fixture.

connections.title: Oklahoma! reset the Broadway book musical in 1943.
connections.explanation: Oklahoma! reset the Broadway book musical in 1943.
connections.name: Oklahoma!
connections.short_description: Rodgers and Hammerstein 1943 musical that reset what a Broadway book show could be.

connections.title: 42nd Street is a backstage musical about Broadway itself.
connections.explanation: 42nd Street is a backstage musical about Broadway itself.
connections.name: 42nd Street (musical)
connections.short_description: Gower Champion / David Merrick backstage musical named for the street itself.

connections.title: Chicago's revival became one of Broadway's longest tenants.
connections.explanation: Chicago's revival became one of Broadway's longest tenants.
connections.name: Chicago
connections.short_description: Kander and Ebb murder-trial musical whose revival became a long Broadway tenant.

connections.title: Les Misérables was a flagship of the 1980s Broadway British invasion.
connections.explanation: Les Misérables was a flagship of the 1980s Broadway British invasion.
connections.name: Les Misérables
connections.short_description: Boublil and Schönberg epic that defined the 1980s British invasion on Broadway.

connections.title: West Side Story is a mid-century peak of the Broadway musical.
connections.explanation: West Side Story is a mid-century peak of the Broadway musical.
connections.name: West Side Story
connections.short_description: Bernstein, Sondheim, and Robbins rewrite of Romeo and Juliet on the West Side.

connections.title: TKTS sells same-day seats that feed Broadway houses.
connections.explanation: TKTS sells same-day seats that feed Broadway houses.
connections.name: TKTS
connections.short_description: Discount-ticket booth under the red glass steps in Duffy Square.

connections.title: Jujamcyn Theaters is the third historic Broadway landlord.
connections.explanation: Jujamcyn Theaters is the third historic Broadway landlord.
connections.name: Jujamcyn Theaters
connections.short_description: Smaller Broadway landlord of houses such as the St. James and Walter Kerr.

connections.title: Rent moved from downtown to become a 1990s Broadway landmark.
connections.explanation: Rent moved from downtown to become a 1990s Broadway landmark.
connections.name: Rent
connections.short_description: Jonathan Larson's East Village rock musical that jumped to Broadway in 1996.

connections.title: The Book of Mormon is a 2010s Tony-winning Broadway long run.
connections.explanation: The Book of Mormon is a 2010s Tony-winning Broadway long run.
connections.name: The Book of Mormon
connections.short_description: Parker, Stone, and Lopez satire that became a 2010s Tony-winning long run.
